content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Section 2.1 (¶p0012) imposes a three-year, USD 2,000,000/year take-or-pay commitment "without reduction or termination rights" — walk-away territory under MINCOMMIT, failing every fallback element (term length, 30-day reduction right, true-up instead of penalty). It also contradicts Section 12.3's "no minimum-volume commitment" acknowledgement and Section 7.1's Order-Form-only fee limitation.

**Cure:** a single surgical replacement of the commitment sentence with the preferred position — no minimum purchase or volume commitment, payment only for Services used or ordered. No provision cross-refers to Section 2.1, so no collateral edits were required, and the replacement removes both the "reduction" and "termination" restrictions together rather than curing only one.
